Let me reconsider the problem. Maybe I need to click on other parts of the board, not just the blue blocks. Let me look at the segmentation again:
- White regions: 3 regions
- Gray region: 1 large region
- Blue blocks: 4 blocks
- Black bars: 3 bars
- Light green (N) bars: 2 bars
Maybe I need to click on the black bars or the N bars? Or maybe I need to click on the gray region?
Let me try clicking on the N bars to see what happens. The N bars are:
- N bar 1: rows 40-43, cols 28-29 (8px)
- N bar 2: rows 52-57, cols 8-9 (12px)
Let me try clicking on N bar 1 first.
